summary: Apply two blocking clarifications to make guarded unknown-run behavior implementable within the approved product files.

items.title: Missing target state for unknown preparing run guards
items.rationale: An explicit missing run needs an isolated empty preparing target snapshot so existing shared mismatch logic sees a non-null target without changing flow-target-guard ownership.
items.evidence: src/lib/flow-target-guard.js treats a null state as no mismatch; Issue 431 limits product changes to flow-context, base-command, dispatcher, and registry.

items.title: Unknown run error contract conflicts with guard-free preservation
items.rationale: ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH applies when expectations are supplied; guard-free unknown-run calls retain their existing command-specific failure contracts.
items.evidence: Issue 431 requires guard-free documented behavior unchanged and target guard mismatch behavior before side effects.
